project_name: Best Bets - NBA Player Prop Dashboard

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Player names

visual_enhancers.shadows: none (flat) or subtle ambient for active states
visual_enhancers.demon_effect: Purple pulsing border or shadow for demon lines

Button.style: h-9 px-4 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50

Badge.style: inline-flex items-center rounded-sm border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

instructions_to_main_agent: Install necessary fonts via Google Fonts import in index.css: Barlow Condensed (600, 700, 800), JetBrains Mono (400, 500).
Enforce Dark Mode by adding 'dark' class to html/body or configured in tailwind.config.js.
Implement the 'Demon Line' logic: If line_type == 'demon', apply the purple glow effect defined in colors.accents.demon_glow.
For the 'Best Bets' table, use a dense layout. Row height should be small (h-10 or h-12).
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dialog, Popover, Command) but style them to match the 'Midnight Terminal' theme.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors with subtle borders.
Ensure the 'Confidence %' and 'Demon' columns are conditionally rendered based on user subscription tier (mocked for now).
Use Recharts for any historical trend graphs (hit rate over last 10 games).
Add a 'Live' indicator (green pulsing dot) next to the odds to show real-time status.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable in marketing sections, but KEEP IT DENSE for the dashboard data table.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

parallel_tool_usage.core_principle: Execute tools in parallel by default.
